verdict.rationale: Drata documents a connections concept ('Understanding Connections in Drata') and a Custom Connections API for linking on-premise tools and custom systems to automate evidence collection. Personnel and Devices endpoints imply ingestion of identity, HR and device data. The only explicit read-only claim is for the Drata endpoint agent's access to system preferences, not for cloud or SaaS integration scopes. missing for 10: an evidenced integrations catalog naming cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM and ticketing connectors; documented read-only permission scopes for those integrations; independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting a real stack.
